firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently paid for something receives the starting-player marker and begins the planning phase.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: With three or more players, the marker holder chooses a plan first, followed clockwise by the others. The chosen plans determine order for the remaining phases.
With two players, the marker holder first blocks a plan with a neutral marker. The opponent blocks another and chooses their own plan; the marker holder then chooses from the remaining plans.
